title: Geometry Dash Chest Open
blurb: Four hours of cooldown compressed into one satisfying crack, usually followed by the crushing disappointment of forty orbs and a shard you already had. That is the chest-opening sound from Geometry Dash's treasure room, and it is a small masterpiece of variable-reward design — the sound is always great, the contents almost never are. Anybody who has set a phone alarm for a large chest timer knows precisely what this does to the brain. Play it whenever you open something with unwarranted optimism.
origin: The treasure room chest sound from Geometry Dash.
